title: Qt: Fix most of Qt6 compile warnings and issues
description: This fixes most of the compile warnings and issues for Qt6. It can compile Wireshark with a working Qt6 6.2 version.

notes.body: @geraldcombs this should lead to a compiling Wireshark. At least for me on Mac it does. But I don't like it, as the casts from longlong to int seem too broad-minded in my book. But for now this works and we can build with 6.2.
I added a qsizetype typedef in !6486, but I agree that the casts aren't ideal. It looks like that conflicts with this MR, unfortunately.
I'm going to go ahead and merge !6486 since it uses static_casts as Jaap recommended.
...and I fixed the conflicts and went ahead and pushed them to your branch: https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/merge_requests/allow_collaboration.html. Hope that's OK.
